append.text: **Ps 60:2 *Exáudi, Deus, deprecatiónem meam: * inténde oratióni meæ* → *Escutai, Deus, a minha prece: * atendei à minha oração*** — the third of the four parallels; the opening = 54:2 (rule 6); no reader remarked; the stylist's best line.
Ps 60:2 *deprecatiónem meam* → *a minha prece* (at the mediant) — applied; no remark.

**Ps 60:5 *Inhabitábo in tabernáculo tuo in sǽcula* → *Habitarei pelos séculos na vossa tenda*** (the row's named place; the adverb moved so the colon does not end on *séculos*); the blind reader heard a camping tent as well. The colon is the Tract of 01-31 and is adapted in an All Saints antiphon (11-01) — *tabernáculo* the option.
Ps 60:5 *prótegar* → *serei protegido* (future passive; the Latinist at the gate noted a jussive reading is possible — the Greek is future); MS1932 *abrigar-me-ei* the option.

**Ps 60:5 *in velaménto alárum tuárum* → *ao abrigo das vossas asas*** — *velaméntum* has the same Greek (σκέπη), so D15 joins it to this row. The Latinist asked twice (minor) for the concrete *sob o véu* / *sob a cobertura*; held, both options. 62:8b *in velaménto alárum tuárum* should copy.

**Ps 60:4 *turris fortitúdinis* → *torre de força*** (no article, as the Latin; the Preces versicle *Esto nobis, Dómine, turris fortitúdinis*); passed every reader. *uma torre de força*, *torre forte*, *torre de fortaleza* options.

**Ps 60:4 *a fácie inimíci* → *diante do inimigo*** (= 43:17; also the response of the Prime Preces versicle, which reads alone). The Latinist (minor) asked *contra a face do inimigo*; held for 43:17, an option.
**Ps 60:4 *Deduxísti me* → *Vós me guiastes*** (the stylist: the enclitic *Guiastes-me* at a verse head sounded bookish; a subject pronoun, D2); passed the gate.

**Ps 60:9 *ut reddam vota mea de die in diem* → *para pagar os meus votos de dia em dia*** — the formula held against the stylist's *cumprir* (a second request, after Ps 55); the blind reader heard vows first. The colon is the R. of the Prime Preces (*V. Sic psalmum dicam …*).
Ps 60:3 *in petra exaltásti me* → *sobre uma rocha me exaltastes* — copied from 26:6 as the row asked; the stylist's *sobre a rocha* refused.

**Ps 60:8 *misericórdiam et veritátem ejus quis requíret?* → *a sua misericórdia e verdade, quem as procurará?*** — the row's verb keeps the Latin's openness (fathom / seek); the stylist asked *buscará* (*quǽrere*'s) and the blind reader found the point unclear. *sondará* (MS1932) the option.
Ps 60:5 applied (*pelos séculos*, moved before *na vossa tenda* for the cadence).
Ps 60:8 *Pérmanet in ætérnum in conspéctu Dei* → *Ele permanece para sempre na presença de Deus* (abiding before God, as 49:8); *à vista de Deus* the option.
